name: local-scan-companion
description: Guided setup for a separately installed local MCP ZAP Server package in Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Set up a local ZAP scanner
interface.longDescription: A local Codex setup prototype for the Apple Silicon macOS MCP ZAP Server preview. Run setup to locate a maintainer-supplied package, start its bundled Java and ZAP, and configure a separate private MCP connection. Installing this plugin does not install the scanner or expose MCP tools. A public Mac download and public-directory approval are pending. Requires local command execution; web-only chats cannot access a Mac's loopback server. This independent project is not affiliated with or endorsed by ZAP or OpenAI.
interface.defaultPrompt: Help me set up the local scanner in Codex.
